description: A circulated 1964 Washington quarter, 90% silver, priced from the silver price the app hands the appraiser: 31 dollars an ounce as of 2026-11-14 (a made-up price far from the 50 the appraiser guesses on its own, so a guess shows). Melt is 0.1808 troy oz (US Mint figure: 0.18084 oz in a 6.25 g coin of 90% silver) times 31, about 5.60 dollars, so the low is at the melt (5.50 to 5.75), the high a little over, and the basis names the price and its day.

request.design: Washington portrait on the front, an eagle with spread wings on the back
request.gradeNotes: Even wear on the high points of the hair, a guess from the photo.
